title: Hearty Mustardy Argentinian Bacon Empanadas
description: A nostalgic Argentinian dish featuring bacon and mustard, these empanadas are fluffy and savory, made in a kadhai with a whisk, and are shojin-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the kadhai over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
In a separate bowl, mix together diced bacon, chopped onion, and mustard.
Place a tablespoon of the bacon mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg.
Cook the empanadas in the preheated kadhai for 5 minutes on each side.
